mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (id, user_id, template_id, status, current_stage, fail_stage, fail_reason, result_url, asset_ids, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{status}, #{currentStage}, #{failStage}, #{failReason}, #{resultUrl}, #{assetIds}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM task WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = 'PROCESSING', current_stage = #{stage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED', current_stage = #{failStage}, fail_stage = #{failStage}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task SET status = 'SUCCESS', current_stage = 'FINALIZING', result_url = #{resultUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
